name: seated pec dec on a chair
description: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Open them back to the sides under control.
